activity_context.topic_title: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables

feedback.problem:
Consider a game of chance with $4$ prizes ($$1$, $$2$, $$3$, and $$5$) where each outcome has a specific probability of happening, shown in the table below. 

| $\text{Number}$ | $\text{Probability}$ |
| --- | --- |
| $$1$ | $25%$ |
| $$2$ | $25%$ |
| $$3$ | $30%$ |
| $$5$ | $20%$ |

What is the expected profit per game?

The expected profit is $$$
{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
Let $p$ represent the profit on a single game, in dollars. Using the given probabilities, let's summarize this in a table. If $f(p)$ is the probability mass function for $p,$ then we have the following:

| $f(p)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{10}$ | $\frac{1}{5}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $p$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $5$ |

Therefore, the expected value of $p$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[p] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+5\cdot f(5) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+2(\frac{1}{4})+3(\frac{3}{10})+5(\frac{1}{5}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{2}+\frac{9}{10}+1 \\  & =\frac{5+10+18+20}{20} \\  & =\frac{53}{20} \\  & =2.65.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the expected profit is $$\,2.65.$
